_about: In-game hint lines (Sal, 2026-10-31), final wording for the UI: one short friendly line per tutorial step, 12 words or fewer, each checked against what the game really does (source: TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md and starter_goals.json). `trigger` names the moment to show it (the guide's step triggers); `goal` links a starter goal where one exists. Keys the HUD needs: id, trigger, text. A hint with a `goal` or `box` true comes up in the OK box (src/client/hint_card.gd, Dave 28 Nov 2026), the rest as a passing line.

hints.text: Walk with W A S D. Hold Shift to run.
Press Tab to see Health, Food, Water, Temperature and Energy.
Stand at the edge of a river or lake and press E to drink. Sea water is too salty.
Press E to pick things up. Hold E to take everything near.
Press E on nettles or tall grass to get plant fibre.
Press I, pick Twine, and craft it from 3 fibre.
Craft a Stone - Axe: 1 stone, 1 stick, 2 twine.
Drag the axe to the hotbar, then press its number key.
Hold the axe and click a tree again and again.
Your tree is down. Gather what fell: sticks, leaves, bark and logs.
Craft a Stone - Hammer: 1 stone, 1 stick, 1 twine. You build with it.
Craft a Campfire: 6 sticks and 16 stones.
Hold the Campfire and click the ground. Under trees it survives rain.
Put sticks or wood on the fire (F), then stand close and press E to light it.
Press F at the fire to put in sticks or wood.
Press F at a burning fire to put meat or fish in; it cooks there.
Hold your hammer, press R and pick Lean-to: 20 sticks, 60 leaves, 6 twine.
Click to build it, open side towards you.

Make a bed: a Thatch - Bed from your pack (10 thatch, 4 sticks, 2 twine) or a Straw - Bed from the hammer's build list (hold the hammer, press R and type straw in the search box). Place it inside your lean-to.
Place the bed under cover, then hold Z to sleep.
A Wooden - Workbench: hold your hammer, press R and pick it. 16 sticks, 6 twine, 8 stones. At it you make cobblestones, stone blocks, wooden pins, the Scraper and more.
Hammer (press R): Crude - Roof 45 or 65. A roof panel rests on a wall top, a ceiling edge or another panel's end: aim at one and face across it. The mouse wheel flips it to rise or fall.
Craft a Wooden - Spear from a stick, then a Stone - Spear with 1 stone and 2 twine.
Craft a Stone - Knife, then work the animal you killed.
Catch a fish: jab a Fishing spear into shallow water, or make a Fishing rod (its Hook is carved from a bone).
Press M for your map. It fills in as you explore.
Pick berries or fruit with E and eat them. Put raw meat in the fire with F.
You are cold: stand near a fire or put on hide clothes.
Night is dark. Craft a Simple - Torch: a stick, a twine and a plant fibre.
Press E at a fruit tree to pick. Pack weight limits you.
Ripe fruit spoils fast. Eat it soon, or dry and cook it.
Apples ripen through the year. Keeping apples last until spring.
At the tide line press E to gather seaweed, shellfish or crabs.
With a Clay - Pot, Bucket, Clay jug or Waterskin at the sea, press E for sea water.
Boil 2 sea water in the Campfire pot to make Salt. Salt keeps meat and fish.
The season changed. Check what ripens now and what you must store.
Winter is near. Smoke fish, dry fruit and store food now.
Hold the Campfire and click the ground. Under trees it survives rain.
Digging out a roof support can bring it down. Prop the ceiling.
Put raw meat in the campfire with F. Cook plants in a pot.

The campfire cooks only meat. Plants cook in a pot: fire 6 clay into a Clay - Pot at this campfire, then hold the hammer, press R, pick Campfire pot and click on the fire (3 sticks, 3 twine, 1 Clay - Pot).
Put 3 berries and water in the pot for Stewed berries. Baked food needs a clay hearth: 10 bricks, 6 clay and 8 stones, built with a hammer.
Nettles give plant fibre and their leaves (Nettles). Steep 3 with water in the campfire pot for tea.
